title: Wellcome Early-Career Award
duration: Usually 5 years, but may be less for some disciplines, and may only be longer if held on a part-time basis
description: The Wellcome Early-Career Award funds early-career researchers from any discipline who are ready to develop their research identity and lead their own independent research programme. Certain costs sit outside the £400,000 limit, including overheads, overseas allowances, adjustment support, and the cost of macaques purchased from the MRC Centre for Macaques. program_type: Government research scholarship (Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students, FCS/ESKAS)

title: Swiss-European Mobility Programme (SEMP)
official_source: State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI), Switzerland - implemented by Movetia
program_type: Government mobility programme (higher education), Swiss solution to Erasmus+
duration: 2 to 12 months per mobility (a stay must last between 60 days and 12 months); one or two semesters for study mobility
description: The Swiss-European Mobility Programme is Switzerland's national mobility programme for higher education and forms part of the Swiss solution to the EU's Erasmus+ programme. program_type: Government mobility programme (higher education), Swiss solution to Erasmus+ - incoming mobility

description: Incoming mobility to Switzerland is funded under the Swiss-European Mobility Programme (SEMP), the higher education part of the Swiss Programme for Erasmus+ that Switzerland operates in place of Erasmus+ association.
